title: Los Santos Alive Realtime NPCs | Simulation 2.0 Teaser (Powered by Gemini Flash)
author: Hutch_230
selftext: Full realtime player-npc and npc-npc interaction mod.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Super cool, it is just talking or is an LLM controlling actions too?

replies.author: Hutch_230
replies.body:
LLMs full controlling actions too, but a ton of work went to ensuring states work properly, context is properly developed at the right times and in the right formats for the most immersive experience

so NPCs can fully talk to other NPCs and perform actions in these conversations reacting to situations, starting fights, pulling a gun, etc.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
This is super interesting to me, are you planing to share code or anything?  Are you hooking into existing NPC states that GTA provides?

Can the LLM do things like have an NPC walk to a specific place or is it only stance changes?

replies.author: Hutch_230
replies.body:
The LLM's ability to make decisions in the game vastly increases with every update, now they're able to by inference go to any place to do actions

For example if they want to eat a donut they'll find a local spot that sells donuts, and they know the difference between where  they can go and where they can't, for example a police officer knows they can get a coffee from the breakroom at the police station so they'll drive there since its closest, but a civillian wont think of that

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Very cool, what's the best way to keep up with your updates?
